brief: A macOS menu bar app showing focus state through color and subtle motion — not a timer, an ambient presence

dominant_strengths: Atmospheric purple gradient with diffuse orbs evokes calm presence — color and mood align with the ambient brief
Restrained typography hierarchy (bold title, soft body) reads cleanly against the dark wash without competing
Single focus pill with violet indicator suggests state without imposing timer-like control structure
dominant_weaknesses: Presented as a marketing landing page, not a menu bar artifact — zero evidence of native macOS menu bar context or scale
Composition floats in vast empty canvas; the actual product surface (the pill) is tiny and disconnected from the orbs
Ambient orbs feel decorative rather than diegetic — they don't read as the focus state itself, just background art
fix_priorities: Reframe as an actual menu bar dropdown anchored to the system bar, with the orb as the bar icon driving the metaphor
Tie the orb's color/motion directly to focus state changes so the visual IS the status, not adjacent to it
Tighten composition: collapse hero text, let the ambient surface dominate at product scale
Add state variants (idle, focus, deep focus) to prove the ambient system, not a single still frame
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral atmosphere and reflective concept, but behavioral layer is nearly absent — we can't tell how it actually lives in the menu bar.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the ambient mood beautifully but fails the 'macOS menu bar app' half of the brief, reading as a concept poster rather than a system-integrated presence.
